description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK, responsible for providing endpoint discovery configurations through various methods such as environment variables, INI files, and fallback logic. It includes methods for creating default providers, environment-based providers, INI file parsers, and unwrapping configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various methods to generate and manage endpoint discovery configurations, including environment-based, INI file-based, fallback, and default providers, with support for caching and unwrapping configurations.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables for endpoint discovery enabled flag.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options, checking service model for required operations to enable endpoint discovery.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider from a specified or default INI configuration file, with support for profiles.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
